messages:
Zoe: Quick thread for Chicago Community Hack Night next Thurs. Need final checklist: booth signage proof, swag qty confirmation, speaker slide short-form for on-screen loop, and the post-event webinar funnel. Owners?
Arun: I'll own swag + signage proof. Update: vendor can deliver all SKUs but low on enamel pins. They offered a pin alternative (keychains) or extra stickers. Thoughts? :pinching_hand:
Tess: prefer extra stickers over keychains — easier to pack and cheaper. Approve stickers as backup.
Arun: Done. Swag final: 200 tees, 300 stickers, 50 notebooks, pins -> replaced by stickers (100). Invoice: https://orders.vendor/INV-2334
Marco: I'll own the webinar funnel and inbound routing. Plan: use simple QR -> Google Form -> Zapier -> HubSpot list "events_chicago". Auto-email triggers: immediate thank-you + webinar signup; 4-day nurture: benchmarks brief; 12-day SDR outreach.
Zoe: Marco, paste the Zap field mapping and the opt-in check. SalesOps wants exact hubspot property names to preload routing rules.
Marco: mapping:
```
full_name -> contact.firstname + contact.lastname (split)
email -> contact.email
company -> company.name
interest -> contact.hs_lead_source_detail
source -> contact.hs_source = "chicago_hacknight"
consent -> contact.marketing_consent
```
Filter: email exists && consent == true
I'll share the Zap editor and a preview export by EOD.
Tess: For the on-site demo screen we need a 30s headline + 2-slide summary that fits 1080x1920 vertical loop. I can compress Maria's benchmark doc into two slides but legal flagged the exact 95p latency. Use relative phrasing like "industry-leading sub-100ms med-latency on common prompts" until sign-off.
Zoe: Legal already asked to avoid absolute p95 numbers. @ops-bot when's the legal cutoff for content?
ops-bot: Legal review ETA 24 hours if submitted now. Reminder: booth art proof due 48 hours before print cutoff: https://ops.redwood/print-deadlines
Arun: I'll upload proof in the morning. If legal not cleared by then, we'll use the generic two-slide: title + CTA to scan QR for more.
Marco: Webinar CTA copy: "See Redwood's approach to predictable inference — sign up for our post-event demo + Q&A." I'll craft the email and post drafts for review.
Zoe: Lead capture fallback: phone QR might fail. Bring clipboard and a stack of business-card-sized signup cards. Design capture: name, email, company, interest (demo/benchmarks/webinar). Someone should upload scanned cards nightly.
Arun: Packing list so far: booth pop-up, two roll-ups, iPad (2) for QR, tablet stands, business cards (300), chargers (4), HDMI adapter, extra polos (30), backup hotspot.
Tess: Speakers: we have a community lightning slot at 7pm. Need 5-min slide deck + 1-line bio. Also AV: confirm whether HDMI or USB-C provided. @ops-bot can you confirm?
ops-bot: AV contact: chris@venuechicago.com. Recommended connectors: HDMI + USB-C; lavalier mic available on request. Submit AV rider 72hrs pre-event. See: https://ops.redwood/av-guidelines
Marco: Demo fallback: prerecord 90s video of the demo to run on loop if WiFi is flaky. Arun, can infra provide a local model image to run offline for the recording?
Arun: Yes, I'll coordinate with infra. Need a clean laptop and the final demo script. Marco please share script by tomorrow.
Zoe: Media: we'll have one on-site media pack (one-paragraph company blurb + hi-res logos + one-pager). Tess please attach link when ready.
Tess: Will do. Also drafting a short event blurb for social: 2 lines + link to webinar signup. Posting later today.
Zoe: Final ask: badge-scan fallback — if iPad app fails, capture phone # (opt-in) and use SMS webhook to send immediate webinar signup link. Confirm legal ok with SMS?
ops-bot: SMS outreach requires explicit consent flag. Ensure form sets consent=true. HubSpot property: marketing_consent must be true.
Arun: Noted. I'll include consent checkbox on the QR form and printed card.
Marco: Timeline recap: Zap live by Wed noon; swag delivered Fri AM; signage proof uploaded by Wed EOD; prerecord video by Thurs AM; legal sign-off expected Wed evening.
Zoe: Thanks. Quick sync tomorrow 9am to verify proof upload and Zap access. Post any blockers here before then. :white_check_mark:
